zh-CN.title: 广场导航层级更清晰
items: 当前栏目保留醒目的下划线，广场与投稿入口调整为低调的工作区切换
未读提示降低视觉强度，更容易辨认当前浏览位置

en.title: Clearer hierarchy in Square navigation
items: Active tabs keep the underline while Square and submission links become quieter workspace switches
Unread indicators are less prominent so the current location stays clear
